cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Outdo the Effort
cards.instruction: Answer every favor, chore, or sacrifice with a bigger one that restores your lead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thanks for the lift. My lessons in looking after people are finally paying off. I'll take your Saturday shift.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I already covered yours yesterday so you could rest.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good initiative. I'll cover your whole weekend; you haven't overtaken your teacher yet.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I swapped Sunday already so I could drive you to the airport.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll cancel the flight and cover your holiday. Watch how it's done: you can send your teacher a postcard from somewhere restful.

heightening.evidence: A5 sacrifices the purpose of the favor itself to exceed B4 effort and preserve teacher standing.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 postcard request is a patronizing way to make B accept the larger break, not just a detached winner declaration.
